datasets.name: Ya'an landslide hazard interpretation data (2021–2023)
datasets.source: Ya'an Bureau of Natural Resources and Planning
datasets.verbatim: For this study, a detailed landslide hazard interpretation was completed in Ya’an based on field landslide site survey data for 2021–2023 from the Ya’an Bureau of Natural Resources and Planning

datasets.name: Google Earth imagery
datasets.verbatim: The historical optical satellite images were provided by Google Earth.

datasets.name: 1:10,000 DEM of Ya’an City
datasets.verbatim: DEM data were obtained from the 1:10,000 DEM of Ya’an City with an accuracy of 5 m

datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.source: Ji, S.; Yu, D.; Shen, C.; Li, W.; Xu, Q. Landslide Detection from an Open Satellite Imagery and Digital Elevation Model Dataset Using Attention Boosted Convolutional Neural Networks. Landslides 2020, 17, 1337–1352.
datasets.verbatim: we conducted a test on a publicly available landslide dataset [54] of Bijie City, Guizhou Province, China.

methods.name: Swin Transformer-based model
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation model based on the Swin Transformer architecture, which fuses optical imagery and DEM data as input and incorporates a boundary loss function to address category imbalance and improve boundary recognition.

availability.author_statement: The original contributions presented in the study are included in the article, further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not linked or publicly available, and the custom Swin Transformer-based model code is not provided.
